top_signals.title: Stocks in Asia Fluctuate, Bonds Drop After Fed: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks swung between gains and losses on Thursday as a deepening selloff in semiconductor shares extended losses in the US. Long end of Treasuries dropped, sending yields to their highest levels in almost two decades amid uncertainty over the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook.
